messages.subject: Problem using Magick and Shiny...
parts:
Dear All,

I've mad a small app that first load a pdf file and then manipulates it and finaly writes it. It works fine on my computer but when upoading it to shinyapps.io then the resolution of the pdf becomes really bad. I use the package Magick and load the pd using the command:

 pdffig <- image_read("www/foo.pdf",density="400x400")

On my computer I can change resolution using density but that doesnt seem to be possible when uploading it, it has the same bad resolution all the time. I did some googleing and found that

library(Cairo)
options(shiny.usecairo=T)

might work but didnt change anything. Hopefully someone here has a solution!

Best,
Johan
